sql: SELECT t.a,j.value FROM t1 t JOIN json_each(json_array(t.a,NULL)) j WHERE j.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.a
SELECT t.a,j.value FROM t1 t LEFT JOIN json_each(json_array(t.a,NULL)) j ON j.value=t.a WHERE t.a<4 ORDER BY t.a
SELECT t.a,j.value FROM t1 t JOIN json_each('bad') j WHERE t.a<0
SELECT t.a,j.value FROM t1 t JOIN json_each(json_array(t.a)) j WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 WHERE j.value=t.a) ORDER BY t.a DESC LIMIT 2
